description:
The second season of Em-Shade! Shorts mini animations, the shorts were initially broadcasted on television, then uploaded onto the KADOKAWA Anime YouTube channel.
Additionally, the shorts are available as extras on the Blu-ray and DVD releases of The Eminence in Shadow Season 2.

Notes:
- Volume 1 includes episodes 1-4.
- Volume 2 includes episodes 5-8.
- Volume 3 includes episodes 9-12.
